job.title: Internal Sales Co-ordinator
job.description:
WSR is recruiting for an Internal Sales Coordinator for our reputable client in Milton Keynes.

Role Title: Internal Sales Coordinator – Service & Spare Parts
Role Type: Permanent
Location: Milton Keynes
Working Hours: 8:30am – 5pm
Working Pattern: Fully office-based for the first 6 months, moving to hybrid working following successful completion of probation (3 days office / 2 days working from home)

 

Internal Sales Coordinator Role Overview:

We’re looking for an experienced Internal Sales Coordinator to join a busy service and spare parts team in Milton Keynes. This is a varied role combining internal sales support, customer service, order processing and administration, making it a great opportunity for someone who enjoys taking ownership of the full customer order journey.

You’ll be working closely with customers, internal service teams and suppliers, managing everything from initial quotations through to order processing, delivery and invoicing. Previous SAP experience and experience handling and processing spare parts orders are essential for this position.

 

Internal Sales Coordinator Key Responsibilities:

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:

  • Preparing quotations for spare parts and modifications and following these up with customers
  • Receiving and processing customer orders, checking them against quotations and issuing order acknowledgements
  • Processing sales orders through SAP from receipt through to invoicing
  • Monitoring outstanding orders and working with relevant teams to ensure deliveries remain on track
  • Managing customer enquiries and providing updates throughout the order process
  • Liaising with internal service teams, technical colleagues and suppliers both within the UK and internationally
  • Coordinating transport and shipment requirements, including urgent breakdown orders where required
  • Maintaining accurate quotation, order and customer activity records within the CRM system
  • Working with Credit Control on credit limits, new customer accounts and account queries
  • Resolving invoice queries and supporting Finance with spare-parts-related matters
  • Managing spare parts returns, credits and associated documentation
  • Raising purchase orders and obtaining relevant approvals
  • Maintaining import/export documentation and administrative records
  • Monitoring shared inboxes and ensuring enquiries and requests reach the appropriate teams
  • Supporting annual stock takes and providing wider administrative support across the team when required
  • Occasionally attending customer, factory or site visits and internal meetings
  • There may also be occasions where you’ll help with the picking, packing and shipment of smaller parts for urgent customer breakdown requirements.


Internal Sales Coordinator Skills, Experience and Attributes:

To be considered for this role, you’ll need:

  • Previous SAP experience – essential
  • Previous experience handling, administering and processing spare parts orders – essential
  • Strong order processing and general administrative experience
  • Experience preparing or managing customer quotations
  • Confidence communicating with customers at different levels
  • Good Microsoft Office skills
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
  • The ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a busy environment
  • A proactive, flexible approach and willingness to support the wider team


Internal Sales Coordinator Benefits (After probation):

  • Holidays: 25 days (with increases based on service).
  • Health: Private healthcare, digital GP access, and mental health support.
  • Enhanced Pay: Generous maternity, paternity, and sick pay.
  • Secure Future: Pension plan, income protection, and life assurance (4x salary).
  • Employee Rewards: Recognition platform, discounts, Cycle 2 Work scheme, and more!

You’ll suit this position particularly well if you enjoy being the person who keeps things moving behind the scenes – coordinating customers, orders, suppliers and internal departments while making sure nothing gets missed.

This is a great opportunity to join an established technical/service environment in a role offering plenty of variety, customer interaction and responsibility across the complete sales and order process.

job.title: Regional Sales Manager
job.description:
WSR is recruiting for a Regional Sales Manager for our reputable client in Milton Keynes.

 

Regional Sales Manager – Slice & Pack

Location: Regional – covering England, Scotland & Wales
Salary: £60,000–£70,000 + uncapped commission
Benefits: Company car or car allowance

We’re looking for an experienced Regional Sales Manager with a strong background in capital equipment sales within the food processing or food packaging industry.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who understands the slice and pack environment and can combine technical solution selling with strong relationship management and business development. Experience working with slicing, portioning, loading, packing or associated food production technologies is particularly important for this position, ideally within meat, poultry, cheese or prepared food environments.

Regional Sales Manager Role Overview:

You’ll take responsibility for developing business across England, Scotland and Wales, managing and growing established customer relationships while also identifying new business opportunities across the territory.

This is a varied sales role combining account development and new business, where you’ll work closely with customers to understand their production requirements, identify opportunities for capital equipment and integrated solutions, and manage projects through the full technical sales cycle.

Regional Sales Manager Key responsibilities will include:

  • Developing and growing key customer accounts
  • Identifying new customers, projects and capital equipment opportunities
  • Building strong relationships with production, engineering, operations and procurement teams
  • Conducting customer site surveys and process reviews
  • Managing technical and commercial proposals
  • Supporting equipment demonstrations, trials and customer visits
  • Managing your sales pipeline, CRM information and forecasting
  • Supporting commercial negotiations and project handovers
  • Attending relevant exhibitions and industry events
  • Travelling regularly throughout the UK territory, with occasional European travel

Regional Sales Manager Skills, Experience & Attributes:

You’ll be an experienced technical sales professional who is comfortable selling capital equipment and solutions into food manufacturing environments.

Ideally, you will have:

  • Proven capital equipment sales experience within food processing or food packaging
  • Direct knowledge of slicing and packing processes or equipment, including areas such as slicing, portioning, loading and packing
  • Experience within sectors such as meat, poultry, cheese or prepared foods
  • A strong track record across both account management and new business development
  • Experience managing longer and more complex technical sales cycles
  • A consultative, solution-led approach to sales
  • Strong commercial and negotiation skills
  • Confidence communicating with operational, engineering and technical stakeholders
  • Good CRM and Microsoft Office skills
  • The ability to manage your own regional territory independently
  • Experience selling integrated production lines, automation systems or wider food production technologies would be particularly advantageous.

 

Regional Sales Manager Benefits:

  • Company car/ car allowance
  • Uncapped commission
  • Holidays: 25 days (with increases based on service).
  • Health: Private healthcare, digital GP access, and mental health support.
  • Enhanced Pay: Generous maternity, paternity, and sick pay.
  • Secure Future: Pension plan, income protection, and life assurance (4x salary).
  • Employee Rewards: Recognition platform, discounts, Cycle 2 Work scheme, and more!

 

What’s On Offer?

This is a senior, autonomous sales opportunity offering the opportunity to develop established customer relationships while also creating new opportunities across a substantial UK territory.

Key Responsibilities

  • Enter and process sales quotations, customer orders and purchase orders accurately.
  • Proactively track order progress, identifying delays, developments and potential problems.
  • Communicate order requirements to internal teams to support timely execution.
  • Prepare and process packing lists and associated order documentation.

  • Plan and monitor internal and external installation services, ensuring delivery on time and within budget.
  • Participate in French and European trade fairs when required.
  • Assist with incoming telephone enquiries and provide wider administrative support to the business.

The Successful Candidate

  • Fluent in French, German and English, both written and spoken.
  • Previous experience in sales support, sales administration, order processing or customer service.
